## Lines 1-30:
     1 | # MyActuator ESP32 Motor Controller Firmware
     2 | 
     3 | ## Overview
     4 | 
     5 | This firmware implements motor control for all MyActuator motor series using ESP32 microcontrollers. It provides a unified Protocol Abstraction Layer (PAL) that supports CAN bus, RS485 (Modbus RTU), and EtherCAT (CoE) communication protocols.
     6 | 
     7 | ## Supported Motor Series
     8 | 
     9 | - **RMD-X**: Planetary motor (10W - 2kW)
    10 | - **RH**: Harmonic motor (50W - 1.5kW)
    11 | - **CEM**: Cycloid actuator (100W - 1.2kW)
    12 | - **RMD-H**: Direct drive hollow motor (200W - 2kW)
    13 | - **RMD-L**: Direct drive motor
    14 | - **FL**: Linear actuator
    15 | 
    16 | ## Communication Protocols
    17 | 
    18 | - **CAN bus**: ISO 11898-1, 500kbps, 29-bit extended IDs
    19 | - **RS485**: Modbus RTU, 115200 baud, 8N1
    20 | - **EtherCAT**: CoE (CANopen over EtherCAT), 1ms cycle time, DC sync
    21 | 
    22 | ## Project Structure
    23 | 
    24 | ```
    25 | firmware/esp32/
    26 | ├── platformio.ini          # PlatformIO configuration
    27 | ├── src/
    28 | │   ├── main.cpp            # Main entry point
    29 | │   ├── protocols/
    30 | │   │   ├── pal.h           # Protocol Abstraction Layer header
